## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger, before/after behavior and related issue.

## Validation

List relevant tests/checks and their results, with limitations. Use keyless
fixtures; no credentials or raw private provider responses.

## Compatibility and contracts

Describe any arena version bump, artifact/protocol migration, privacy boundary
or consumer change. Update applicable schemas, examples, types, documentation
and changelog together. A local test pass or signature does not establish
Official trust.
